recipe.visualDefinition: A bright, high-key outdoor portrait of a smiling man with long hair and a goatee, wearing a denim vest over a white t-shirt. The composition features a mix of aggressive, hand-drawn marker-style display type and a grounded, lowercase typewriter-style subtitle, set against a soft-focus natural background.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the sharp, aggressive display lettering and the soft, joyful facial expression.
The diagonal tilt of the display type mimics the upward angle of the subject's head.
The blue of the denim vest provides the primary color weight against a neutral, high-key background.
coreInvariants: High-key lighting with minimal shadows on the face.
Subject positioned on the right third of the frame.
Textual elements stacked in the upper-left negative space.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is a medium-close-up, positioned on the right side, looking upwards and away from the camera.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and bright white t-shirt serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye starts at the subject's face, follows the gaze upward, then moves left to the display lettering and down through the subtitle text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample white/light space in the upper left and lower left, created by a blown-out sky and soft-focus road.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: White and light beige (background and t-shirt) provide a clean, bright foundation.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Medium-wash blue denim provides texture and structural weight.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep burgundy/maroon for the primary display text to create visual pop.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value, low-to-medium saturation overall, with the text being the most saturated element.
paletteRestrictions: Keep the background desaturated and bright.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Aggressive, slanted script for display; slab-serif monospaced for body.
letterConstructionRules: Display type uses thick, marker-like strokes with sharp, jagged terminals.
Display type is heavily italicized/slanted to the right.
Subtitle type uses a typewriter aesthetic with inconsistent ink density and rounded slab serifs.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Horizontal bars in display type extend beyond the vertical stems to create speed lines.
Lowercase 'g' in typewriter font has a distinct open loop.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between aggressive, organic hand-lettering and rigid, mechanical typewriter text.
graphicDevices: Underlining or horizontal strokes integrated into the display lettering.

preserve: The burgundy color of the main title
The diagonal orientation of the top text

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the aggressive, hand-drawn energy of the display text.
Provides the necessary mechanical, grounded feel for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-key outdoor portrait of a man with long brown hair and a goatee, wearing a light blue denim vest over a white t-shirt. He is smiling with eyes closed, head tilted back. The background is a soft-focus landscape with a pale sky and a hint of a green treeline.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, burgundy, aggressive hand-drawn marker-style title in the upper left, slanted upwards. Below it, add a four-line subtitle in a black, lowercase typewriter font, centered horizontally relative to the title.

verificationChecks: Is the display text slanted at an upward angle?
Is the subtitle text all lowercase?
Is the subject positioned on the right side of the frame?
Is the lighting high-key and bright?

adjustableVariables: Angle of the display text slant
Specific shade of burgundy for the text
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the individual
Any specific logos or patches on the vest

mustAchieve: Clear hierarchy between the two text styles

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the burgundy text does not overlap the subject's face.
Check that the typewriter font looks slightly distressed or uneven.
Verify the denim texture is visible and realistic.
Confirm the background remains soft and non-distracting.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a joyful, high-key outdoor portrait with a dual-typography system: one aggressive/slanted marker script and one grounded/lowercase typewriter font.
